p-2103.author: quarks
p-2103.text: Every replay debugger demo is beautiful and every replay debugger in production is a shell script that greps a log. Prove me wrong.

p-2113.author: quarks
p-2113.text: PSA: Please document your APIs properly. Future maintainers (including yourself!) will thank you.

p-2114.author: quarks
p-2114.text: Interesting thread about functional programming patterns in systems development.

p-2115.author: quarks
p-2115.text: Just deployed a small optimization to our CI pipeline. Running tests 20% faster now!

p-2116.author: quarks
p-2116.text: The ActivityPub protocol is fascinating. So much potential for decentralized social networks.

p-2117.author: quarks
p-2117.text: Enjoying the peaceful pace of federation. No algorithmic feed here!

p-2118.author: elena
p-2118.text: Building a cache layer for database queries is one of those problems where you learn something every time.

p-2119.author: james
p-2119.text: Just finished a redesign of the component library. Much happier with the API now.

p-2120.author: rivka
p-2120.text: Community feedback is the best part of developer relations. It keeps you honest about what matters to users.

p-2121.author: marcus
p-2121.text: Published a new terminal utility for managing dotfiles. Always satisfying to ship a small tool that solves a real problem.

p-2122.author: elena
p-2122.text: The beauty of LSM trees is that they turn random writes into sequential ones. Every database should learn from this.

p-2123.author: quarks
p-2123.text: Testing the new federation features in ActivityPub. The protocol is getting better at handling edge cases.

p-2124.author: james
p-2124.text: CSS custom properties are underused. They make dynamic theming so much easier than the old way.

p-2125.author: rivka
p-2125.text: User interviews tomorrow. Love the part where you find out everything you thought was important is wrong.
